values.note: Ten sites for tents or camping vehicles, some backing onto the Boulder River; each with a picnic table and fire ring with grill. No lengths published.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/galena-gulch-campground ('Galena Gulch Campground features ten first come, first served campsites, which can accommodate tents or camping vehicles', 'Some campsites back up to the boulder river', 'Each site contains a picnic table and fire ring with integrated grill'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Two vault toilets. No potable water or trash service: bring water, pack out trash.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/galena-gulch-campground ('Two vault toilets are available for campers. No potable water or trash service is available; campers should bring their own water and pack out their trash.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: BLM Butte Field Office. 14 days within any 28-day period.

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/galena-gulch-campground ('ten first come, first served campsites', 'No reservations are available.', 'Overnight occupancy is governed by a 14-day maximum stay limit within any 28-day period.'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM (Butte Field Office, not USFS) campground on the Boulder River off I-15 Exit 160 near Basin/Boulder; under the freeway on Galena Gulch Rd, over a small bridge. Please avoid parking on the grass. --Claude
summary: BLM page confirms 10 first-come sites, no reservations, two vault toilets, no potable water, 14-day limit and the $10 fee (charged April 1 - November 30; fees already manual, left). Not stated: hookups (derived none left), a campground season (derived year-round left; only the fee period is given). Note trimmed of restated values.
